description: Decibel primary material establishes live usDCBL use, Bridge issuance, protocol-only availability and stated 1:1 cash/Treasury backing, but exact onchain token contract identity, affiliate-specific Bridge issuing entity, universal direct-redemption eligibility, reserve allocation/custody and insolvency treatment remain unresolved.
notes: Do not infer a token contract, specific Bridge affiliate, universal redemption right, reserve custodian or bankruptcy-remoteness treatment from the reviewed sources.
